description:
Legislative history (travaux préparatoires) of a French statute or bill
(Assemblée nationale files since 2012; key dates only before). Each step of
`parcours` lists its documents (bill, reports, opinions, adopted or rejected
texts: number, date, authors, official URL), votes, minutes, the
Constitutional Council decision and the Official Journal; `issue` says
adopted or rejected. Cite documents by number and URL.

Example: get_legislative_history(loi="2016-1547")

Args:
    query: keywords from the file title (French); OR/AND/NOT in UPPERCASE between
        two words are operators; lowercase words are plain words
    loi: statute number ("2016-1547")
    limit: number of files (max 20)
    steps: include the stages of the shuttle between the two chambers
